newsitem.title: UK: UK's Majestic Wine to seek admission to AIM.
newsitem.headline: UK's Majestic Wine to seek admission to AIM.

text.p: Majestic Wine Plc, the drinks retailer, said on Monday it would seek admission to the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) via a placing of shares with institutional investors.

"Majestic is seeking an AIM listing to raise the profile of the company amongst suppliers, customers and propspective staff and to incentivise staff through the use of share options," said chief executive Tim How.
"The proceeds of the placing will help fund the continuing expansion of the store portfolio and will provide additional working capital for the group," How added.
Williams de Broe will act as adviser to the flotation.
